title: Adalci Tsakanin 'Yan Kasuwa
intro: Wani mutum ya tsaya a gaban mutanen da suka shagaltu da neman riba, yana kiransu da gaskiya da adalci a cikin mu'amalarsu. Wannan bawan Allah ya yi gargaɗi game da bayar da gajerun ma'auni da kuma karkatar da ma'auni. Mutanen sun ƙi saurara, suna barazanar korar wannan mutum daga ƙasarsu. Duniya da kanta za ta tashi tsaye don yin hukunci a kansu. Wanene wannan mutum da ya tsaya don adalci a tsakanin 'yan kasuwa?
clues: An aiko ni a matsayin manzo ga mutanen da suka nutse cikin harkar kasuwanci da kasuwanci sosai.
Mutanena suna yin gajeriyar ma'auni lokacin auna kaya ga wasu.
Sun yi barazanar korar ni daga ƙasar idan na ci gaba da kiransu zuwa ga imani.
Ana tunawa da ni a matsayin mafi iya magana a cikin annabawa.
Mutanena sun yi mummunar girgizar ƙasa wadda ta bar su babu rai a gidajensu.
An aiko ni zuwa ga mutanen Madyan a arewacin Hijaz.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: An yi barazanar korarsa daga ƙasar
Mutanena sun jefa ni cikin wuta mai zafi
Ya fuskanci masu sihirin wani babban Fir'auna
Na fuskanci buƙatar samar da raƙumi daga dutse
Na shaida halakar birnina da rundunar mala'iku suka yi
trial.answer: An yi barazanar korarsa daga ƙasar

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Girgizar ƙasa mai tsanani ta kama mutanena
Mutanena sun nutse cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai tsanani
Mutanena sun watse da iska mai ƙarfi
An cece ni a cikin cikin wani babban kifi
outcome.answer: Girgizar ƙasa mai tsanani ta kama mutanena

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
